objective: Make durable ContextFabric writes a governed runtime operation with atomic workspace+ledger commit, deterministic recovery, and rollback on persistence failure.

rulesConsidered: ContextFabric is the sole active working-context authority.
MongoDB is operational persistence; persistence code cannot become a new authority.
No non-atomic save-then-append downgrade is permitted for the durable commit path.
Recovery must verify persisted context integrity before restoring active state.
Every non-trivial change follows the Team Change Gate.

changes: Added atomic durable ContextFabric commit contract.
Added fail-closed durability-unavailable behavior when transaction support is unavailable.
Added ContextFabric hydrate/recover path with deterministic hash and ledger integrity checks.
Added rollback of in-memory context on failed durable commit.
Bound MongoClient into the runtime persistence path.
Added recovery, stale-writer, rollback, and rehydration tests.
Extended the blocking Context Fabric CI lane.
Recorded Wave C decision and reconciled architecture/index documentation.

verificationResults.note: Fresh PR-217 exact-head validation is required. Mongo transaction/live proof remains UNPROVEN until a real transaction-capable deployment executes the atomic path.
